entity.name: Army Camp
entity.description: Your troops are stationed in Army Camps. Build more camps and upgrade them to muster a powerful army.

entity.name: Barracks
entity.description: The Barracks allow you to train troops to attack your enemies. Upgrade the Barracks to unlock advanced units that can win epic battles.

entity.name: Blacksmith
entity.description: Bring the right magical ores here and your heroes' equipment can be upgraded to be even mightier! The smoke from the furnace helps make delicious, if unhealthy, brisket.

entity.name: Dark Barracks
entity.description: The Dark Barracks will open doors for creatures born out of Dark Elixir. Upgrade the barracks to unlock more troops with unique battle skills.

entity.name: Dark Spell Factory
entity.description: Only the most brilliant or reckless Master Wizards dabble in Dark Elixir brewery. Their compact Dark Spells require keen insight to master, but provide unique tactical advantages.

entity.name: Hero Banner
entity.description: Hero Banners provide a defensive post for your Heroes. They cannot be destroyed in attacks.

entity.name: Hero Hall
entity.description: This fancy Hall honors your Village's mightiest warriors! Visit the Hero Hall for all your heroic essentials, and to upgrade Heroes. Upgrade the Hero Hall to unlock more Heroes!

entity.name: Laboratory
entity.description: What dark secrets do these Wizards hide inside their Laboratory? Nobody has dared to look. All we know is that their research makes our spells and troops harder, better, faster and stronger!

entity.name: Pet House
entity.description: Every hero deserves a loyal companion. The Pet House allows you to unlock powerful Pets with various abilities to fight alongside your heroes.

entity.name: Spell Factory
entity.description: The Spell Factory is home to veteran Wizards who are better suited to creating magical weapons than front-line combat. Use their powerful Attack Spells to turn the tide of a battle in your favor!

entity.name: Workshop
entity.description: The Workshop is where Siege Machines are built. Upgrade the Workshop to unlock different Siege Machines!

entity.name: Air Bombs
entity.description: Barrel after barrel, Air Bombs blast even the mightiest Flying enemies out of the sky. Your village airspace isn't safe with this Builder Base classic around!

entity.name: Bomb Hive
entity.description: Oh, those bombs of ours, they blow up so fast! Bombs leave the nest in straight lines, exploding when they hit a ground or air target.

entity.name: Cake-A-Pult
entity.description: One splash-damage serving at a time! Cake surrounding enemies in destructive and delectable... cake. When this dessert drops, it leaves an explosive surprise, ensuring no one is around for seconds.

modules.name: Explosion Damage
modules.controls: Damage dealt by the bomb left behind when the cake lands

entity.name: Crusher Mortar
entity.description: Bowlers from all around line up to get this thing's autograph! The Crusher Mortar's spiky boulders land with the grace of Golems, before bouncing around for extra collateral damage. Protective headwear is recommended!

entity.name: Flame Spinner
entity.description: Fear the relentless rotating of a repurposed cooking oven! Without ever getting dizzy, the Flame Spinner creates an endless whirlwind of Fire that damages nearby ground and air enemies.

entity.name: Hero Bell
entity.description: The tolling bell ignites the fighting spirit of defending Heroes, boosting their strength and health. When destroyed, Heroes go back to their regular awesome selves. Boo!

entity.name: Hero Hunter
entity.description: Headhunter wants to play a game! This destructive deck dealer targets all troops but serves extra damage to Heroes! Card projectiles cause slowdown and result in poisoned paper cuts.

modules.name: Poison Level
modules.controls: Level of the Poison Spell effect applied by its projectiles

entity.name: Hook Tower
entity.description: The Master Builder won't mind that we borrowed rope from his boat, will he? The Hook Tower pulls in enemies from afar and stuns them. Sadly, Siege Machines are a bit too heavy!

entity.name: Hot Candle
entity.description: The flickering flame of the Hot Candle flings fire spurts at multiple surrounding enemies! Better make your wish quick, as this defense’s target capacity decreases as it melts.

modules.name: Seconds Active
modules.controls: Seconds active in base form before the target count decays

entity.name: Lava Launcher
entity.description: A hot delivery From Builder Base. Lava Launcher spits straight fire at a single target from afar! Its piping-hot projectiles play a dangerous game of The Floor is Lava where ground troops always lose.

modules.name: Range
modules.controls: Maximum range in tiles (minimum range is always 6)

entity.name: Light Beam
entity.description: So bright, even squinting won't help! The Light Beam has very long range, but its luminosity fades with distance. Closer targets take more damage.

entity.name: Roaster
entity.description: Boils up and blasts hot plasma on ground and air enemies. Give your skin a healthy glow by standing at a safe distance.

entity.name: Air Defense
entity.description: This anti-air tower is deadly against flying enemies, but can't target foes on the ground. Place it wisely to cover as much airspace as possible.

entity.name: Air Sweeper
entity.description: Air Sweepers control the sky with strong blasts of air that push back flying enemies. Air Sweepers can only face one direction, so rotate them to maximize their effectiveness.

entity.name: Archer Tower
entity.description: Archer Towers have longer range than Cannons, and unlike Cannons they can attack flying enemies.

entity.name: Bomb Tower
entity.description: Bomb Towers bombard nearby ground troops and go up in a big BOOM when destroyed! Melee units best stand clear!

entity.name: Builder's Hut
entity.description: Nothing gets done around here without Builders! You can hire more Builders to start multiple construction projects, or speed up their work by using green gems.

entity.name: Cannon
entity.description: Cannons are great for point defense. Upgrade Cannons to increase their firepower, but beware that your Defenses cannot shoot while being upgraded!

entity.name: Crafting Station
entity.description: A mysterious machine that can be loaded with one of three powerful crafted defenses. Swap freely between them, then upgrade each one's three modules to make them even stronger!

entity.name: Eagle Artillery
entity.description: The Eagle Artillery has nearly unlimited range and targets tough enemies with exploding shells. However, it won't activate until a large amount of troops have been deployed.

entity.name: Firespitter
entity.description: The Firespitter spews flames at a fire rate faster than the X-Bow! If it misses, the Firespitter will shoot past its target to deal damage to enemies behind. It can only face a single direction, so place carefully!

entity.name: Hidden Tesla
entity.description: Lay a deadly trap with the Hidden Tesla! Our Wizards have trapped a storm cloud into each of these sneaky towers. When an enemy walks or flies close enough, the tower springs up and fries it using the power of Electrickery!

entity.name: Inferno Tower
entity.description: Set the Inferno Tower's Dark Elixir fueled flame to build up unbelievable damage to single targets, or to constantly roast multiple targets at once.

entity.name: Monolith
entity.description: The Builder's first experiment in using Dark Elixir for a building resulted in something truly frightful. The stronger the Monolith's target, the more damage it does. Great to have defending your Village, but a little scary to attack against.

entity.name: Mortar
entity.description: The Mortar can mow down hordes of enemies by the splash damage from its shell. Don't let enemies get too close to it!

entity.name: Multi-Archer Tower
entity.description: These Archers have teamed up to take out attackers faster and more furiously than ever. Teamwork makes the dream work!

entity.name: Multi-Gear Tower
entity.description: The Multi-Gear Tower is a powerful combination of two classic Defenses! Choose the attack mode that suits you and let the destruction begin! Targets air and ground units.

entity.name: Revenge Tower
entity.description: If you destroy its building friends, the Revenge Tower will look for you, it will find you, and it will smite you. As fellow buildings fall, it grows stronger and angrier!

entity.name: Ricochet Cannon
entity.description: Builder has used one weird trick to develop a devastating cannonball that will ricochet and hit a second target.

entity.name: Scattershot
entity.description: The Scattershot heaves very heavy bundles of poorly tied together rocks at whoever happens to be closest. The bundles break apart on impact and deal additional damage to the troops behind.

entity.name: Spell Tower
entity.description: For years, Wizards alone brought magic to the battlefield one fireball at a time. Now they've developed a fully automated way to give your village more ways to mess up attackers with magic!

entity.name: Super Wizard Tower
entity.description: Super Wizard's first strike can shock up to fifteen nearby enemies. Chained targets take less damage.

entity.name: Wizard Tower
entity.description: The Ultimate Arcane Defense! Tower Wizards cast powerful area effect spells that target both flying and ground troops.

field_provenance.reason: Four recovered X-Bows are spaced three tiles apart. The old 4x4 footprint causes ten overlap groups and one out-of-bounds placement in the observed home layout.

entity.name: X-Bow
entity.description: The X-Bow shoots mystical bolts with terrifying power. Load it with Elixir and the X-Bow works automagically. You can set it to target ground units at long ranges, or all targets at reduced range.

entity.name: Logger
entity.description: A hardened meteorite hunk with a fascination for forestry. When Logger isn’t petting his mustache woodpeckers, he’s lobbing bouncing logs that push and crush all troop types. The timber may be slow, but it strikes with the full force of nature!

entity.name: Longshot
entity.description: Use your head! Longshot fires explosive bolts from her cranium at long range, peppering attackers with delightful dollops of splash damage.

entity.name: Smasher
entity.description: This tanky Guardian deals splash damage to ground and air troops. Smasher is a seriously sore loser, raging when the Town Hall is destroyed and leaving rage in his wake when defeated.

entity.description: Summons Giant Giant to fight by the Archer Queen's side

entity.name: Archer Queen
entity.description: Towering above all other Archers, this graceful huntress is a master of destructive force. Although her health is modest, she snipes targets from afar with her powerful X-bow. As a defender she guards the village with a vengeance.

entity.name: Barbarian King
entity.description: Biggest and bravest of all barbarians, this colossal menace soaks up huge amounts of damage and smashes anything in his path with his sword. He guards his territory fiercely when defending.

entity.name: Dragon Duke
entity.description: Locked away for his anger issues, this tanky Flying Hero gets madder and mightier when separated from Friendly Flying units. His royal rampage boosts damage by 100%, attack speed by 50%, and reduces damage taken from traps by half. When defending, he can only be attacked by air-targeting enemies.

entity.name: Grand Warden
entity.description: This powerful master of magic supports Troops by blasting enemies with his Staff! The Grand Warden can even walk or fly over Walls! He'll make a majestic stand at his Hero Banner when defending.

entity.name: Minion Prince
entity.description: The self-proclaimed Prince of Darkness means business! The Minion Prince takes to the skies and damages targets with dark magic! When defending, he can only be attacked by ranged and air units.

entity.name: Royal Champion
entity.description: Over the Wall and at them! The Royal Champion is only afraid of four things, and the enemy isn't one of them. Her short range is perfect for stabbing defenses up close and personal.

entity.name: B.O.B's Hut
entity.description: B.O.B, a totally normal Builder, lives here among us. Definitely not a robot controlled from the Builder Base.

entity.name: Angry Jelly
entity.description: This blob of pure anger gets impatient waiting around the Village, it's hungry for a good fight. During Battle it convinces its Hero to attack Defenses before splitting to fight separately.

entity.name: Diggy
entity.description: Diggy is an introvert and spends a lot of time hiding underground. Still when it comes to battle, he'll do his part, coming up to attack buildings and aid his Hero. If his Hero's taken out, he'll seek out a new one for support, scritches.

entity.name: Electro Owl
entity.description: Electro Owl zaps enemy defenses into dust from great distance. He's mostly made of feathers though, so better keep him well protected!

entity.name: Frosty
entity.description: Frosty is the coolest pet... literally. Not only does his icy breath cause enemies to chill out, but he also releases swarms of Frostmites to further slow down defenses and help his Hero.

entity.name: Greedy Raven
entity.description: No scarecrow is frightning enough to keep Greedy Raven away from shiny loot! This masked bandit's swift feathers target and deal extra damage to resource buildings and egos.

entity.name: L.A.S.S.I
entity.description: The trustiest hound to ever roam the village proper, L.A.S.S.I chases enemies with unrelenting fury. Unless they fly, in which case she just observes them intently.

entity.name: Mighty Yak
entity.description: Built like a Siege Machine, the Mighty Yak has a knack for knocking down Walls it comes in contact with. It also flies into a rage if you knock out its companion.

entity.name: Phoenix
entity.description: A true friend will egg you on when things get rough. Phoenix starts the battle as a helpless egg, but at the moment her Hero might go down, she hatches. The furious fiery fowl then gives temporary invulnerability to its Hero and engages nearby enemies.

entity.name: Poison Lizard
entity.description: Always the fastest never the lastest, Poison Lizard spits slowing toxins at its foes. Is it actually a venom lizard? Possibly, but who's brave enough to correct it?

entity.name: Sneezy
entity.description: Her nose is blocked and loaded! Sneezy hangs behind her Hero due to allergies and sneezes tanky air Boogers that target Buildings. She goes on attack when her Hero falls!

entity.name: Spirit Fox
entity.description: An extremely shy creature, who's happiest alone in the woods outside the Village. When called to battle, Spirit Fox fights fiercely alongside their hero and helps them with a little invisibility.

entity.name: Unicorn
entity.description: Unicorns have severe trust issues, but overcoming them with love and patience is totally worth it. They'll heal up any minor or major scrapes as well as any Healer!

entity.name: Clan Castle
entity.description: The Clan Castle houses your Treasury and any reinforcement troops or spells sent by your clanmates.

entity.name: Dark Elixir Drill
entity.description: Our Builders have finally figured a way to extract pure Dark Elixir, the rarest form of the magical substance.

entity.name: Dark Elixir Storage
entity.description: The power of Dark Elixir could not be contained in a regularly shaped Elixir vat. As it's three times as powerful, we had to invent a cubical form of storage!

entity.name: Elixir Collector
entity.description: Elixir is pumped from the Ley Lines coursing underneath your village. Upgrade your Elixir Collectors to maximize Elixir production.

entity.name: Elixir Storage
entity.description: These storages contain the elixir pumped from underground. Upgrade them to increase the maximum amount of elixir you can store.

entity.name: Gold Mine
entity.description: The Gold Mine produces gold. Upgrade it to boost its production and gold storage capacity.

entity.name: Gold Storage
entity.description: All your precious gold is stored here. Don't let sneaky goblins anywhere near! Upgrade the storage to increase its capacity and durability against attack.

entity.name: Battle Blimp
entity.description: The Battle Blimp bypasses ground-based obstacles and delivers your Clan Castle troops directly into the heart of the enemy village, all while dropping bombs along the way. However, its thin hide makes it easier to shoot down. Immune to spell effects.

entity.name: Battle Drill
entity.description: A fine example of goblin ingenuity, the Battle Drill burrows underground towards the nearest defense. On arrival it pops up to stun and demolish with its dastardly drill.

entity.name: Flame Flinger
entity.description: This little charmer flings bundles of Fire Spirits that both hit hard and leave behind a burning mess. Its long range helps it stay out of trouble, but beware of longer range defenses and traps! Immune to spell effects.

entity.name: Log Launcher
entity.description: While the Log Launcher certainly isn't the fastest or the sturdiest, it is definitely among the meanest. The trunk-throwing contraption pummels everything in front of it with endless logs to open up a path to the enemy Town Hall. Immune to spell effects.

entity.name: Siege Barracks
entity.description: The Siege Barracks parachutes down gracefully to first release a menagerie of P.E.K.K.As and Wizards and then the Clan Castle troops. How they all managed to squeeze inside is a mystery not really worth investigating.

entity.name: Sky Wagon
entity.description: Tell walls to take a hike and drop troops from above. Sky Wagon delivery services are fast, reliable and destructive! Though its wooden body can't withstand a lot of damage, its mastery of the skies and immunity to spells more than make up for it.

entity.name: Stone Slammer
entity.description: The Stone Slammer is a heavy-duty, flying mountain that targets defensive buildings by flattening them with giant boulders and causes earthquakes. Immune to spell effects.
entity.attackType: Area Splash 1 and 3 tile Radius (Ground Only)

entity.name: Troop Launcher
entity.description: This immobile machine launches barrel loads of Troops and Clan Castle Troops at your allies in battle to support them. Each barrel can hold multiple Troops, including one Clan Castle Troop. There's only a few barrels inside, so make them count!

entity.name: Wall Wrecker
entity.description: The Wall Wrecker exists for two simple purposes: smash through anything that it comes across and deliver the Clan Castle troops straight to the heart of the village. Built from heavy-duty materials, it can take a pummeling before breaking down. Immune to spell effects.

entity.name: Angry Spell
entity.description: Distilled from the jelly of the Pet House's grumpiest resident, the Angry Spell infuriates troops within its ironically sweet-smelling radius, making them target defenses temporarily..

entity.name: Bat Spell
entity.description: Summon an army of Bats anywhere on the battlefield! Deploy aerial reinforcements wherever you need them most. Bats do not trigger Traps.

entity.name: Clone Spell
entity.description: Turn this Spell into a pop-up army! Clone Spells create a circle of spawning that creates limited-lifetime copies of troops that enter it. It will only spawn up to a maximum housing space of troops.

entity.name: Earthquake Spell
entity.description: Weaken Walls and buildings with crippling earthquakes! Earthquake Spells damage structures based on their maximum hitpoints. Repeated Earthquakes deal decreasing damage to the same buildings, but increasing damage to the same Walls. No Wall can withstand the might of four Earthquake Spells!

entity.name: Freeze Spell
entity.description: When the going gets hot, stay frosty! The Freeze Spell sends out a cryogenic blast that temporarily immobilizes enemy troops and disables defensive buildings within its radius.

entity.name: Haste Spell
entity.description: Put some hustle in even your heaviest units! Haste Spells lack the damage boost of Rage Spells, but provide an even better boost to movement speed. A lower storage space also allows you to take more of them into battle!

entity.name: Healing Spell
entity.description: Heal your Troops to keep them in the fight! Cast this spell to create a Ring of Healing. Your units will be healed while they are inside this ring.

entity.name: Ice Block Spell
entity.description: Cast this cool concoction to encase your ground and air Troops in ice that blocks almost all damage but Freezes their movement and attack!

entity.name: Invisibility Spell
entity.description: Invisibility Spell makes EVERYTHING except for Walls and Siege Machines invisible and untargetable within its radius.

entity.name: Jump Spell
entity.description: Walls slowing you down? Try making a shortcut! Cast this spell near enemy walls to create a route straight over them. Your troops will jump over affected walls pieces as if they weren't even there!

entity.name: Lightning Spell
entity.description: Electrocute your enemies with a bolt of lightning! Cast this spell at the enemy village to damage and stun buildings and units inside a small area.

entity.name: Overgrowth Spell
entity.description: Ever wish you could ignore a whole chunk of that enemy base? The Overgrowth Spell traps nearby Buildings in tough roots, stopping Defenses attacking. Troops ignore trapped Buildings.

entity.name: Poison Spell
entity.description: Give your army the upper hand against enemy troops with this deadly poison! Defending units that linger in a Poison Spell's toxic cloud will move slower, attack slower and take damage with increasing severity over time. Poison Spells do not affect structures.

entity.name: Rage Spell
entity.description: Enrage your units to make them bigger, faster and stronger! Cast this to create a Ring of Rage! Your units will gain speed and attack power while they are inside this ring.

entity.name: Recall Spell
entity.description: Attack going badly? Need to come in from another direction? The Recall Spell summons back Troops, Heroes and Pets to the deployment bar. You can then send the recalled units back out for a second strike.

entity.name: Revive Spell
entity.description: The Healer's own special recipe! The Revive Spell brings a defeated Hero in its range back into the fight with some health. Bring this Spell into battle, and a floating golden heart will appear above any defeated Hero that can be revived. Upgrade the Revive Spell to increase the amount of health Heroes regain.

entity.name: Skeleton Spell
entity.description: Summon an army of Skeletons anywhere on the battlefield! Put a few extra swords when and where you need them most. Skeletons do not trigger traps.

entity.name: Totem Spell
entity.description: Hey, look over there! Distract ground and air Defenses by dropping a Totem Spell. Nearby enemies will focus their attack on the Totem, taking the heat off other troops. Forged from dense cosmic rock, the Totem also damages and stuns the area in which it lands.

entity.name: Town Hall
entity.description: This is the heart of your village. Upgrading the Town Hall unlocks new defenses, buildings, traps and much more.

entity.name: Air Bomb
entity.description: Latest invention in the field of flying pest control. This trap can blast multiple air units in a small area.

entity.name: Bomb
entity.description: Bombs are traps that remain hidden until activated by an attacking troop moving into their trigger radius. Once triggered, they must be re-armed for free.

entity.name: Giant Bomb
entity.description: When you're looking for a Big Boom, you need the Giant Bomb. A much more powerful version of the Bomb that deals heavy splash damage to all nearby ground troops.

entity.name: Giga Bomb
entity.description: Villagers didn't want to keep this dangerous Weapon inside the Town Hall, so they moved it out! The Giga Bomb pushes enemies back with massive damage. This Trap is so deadly, it doesn't need to hide!

entity.name: Seeking Air Mine
entity.description: Is it a bird? Is it a plane? Well, it makes no difference as the Seeking Air Mine will blow it sky high. This trap does devastating damage to a single air unit.

entity.name: Skeleton Trap
entity.description: Ambush and distract unsuspecting foes with a surprise skirmish of short-lived, but sneaky skeleton troops! Skeleton Traps can be configured to pursue ground or air troops.

entity.name: Spring Trap
entity.description: Bounces enemy ground units off the battlefield. Units within its spring capacity are ejected instantly. Units exceeding capacity are launched but take damage instead.

entity.name: Tornado Trap
entity.description: Wind and stones may break some bones, but this trap will definitely confound you. Just place one of these traps down and the released vortex will draw the enemy troops in, hindering their progress.

entity.name: Apprentice Warden
entity.description: Despite his grand ambitions, Apprentice Warden is still just a student. Supports troops with his magical Life Aura and less-magical slingshot.

entity.name: Archer
entity.description: These sharpshooters like to keep their distance on the battlefield and in life. Nothing makes them happier than single-mindedly taking down their target.

superTroop.name: Super Archer
superTroop.description: Having achieved serious arm strength, the Super Archer can now threaten targets several buildings away.

entity.name: Super Archer
entity.description: Having achieved serious arm strength, the Super Archer can now threaten targets several buildings away.

entity.name: Baby Dragon
entity.description: This fire-breathing hatchling is shy around other air units, but leave it alone and it'll throw a fit! When not around other air units, Baby Dragons become enraged and gain bonus damage and attack speed.

superTroop.name: Inferno Dragon
superTroop.description: Not getting upset over being alone anymore, the Inferno Dragon has learned to focus its rage into a very powerful beam that builds up over time!

entity.name: Inferno Dragon
entity.description: Not getting upset over being alone anymore, the Inferno Dragon has learned to focus its rage into a very powerful beam that builds up over time!

entity.name: Balloon
entity.description: These promoted skeletons have traded in their joy of destroying walls for a joy of destroying defenses. Deploy them to take out pesky mortars and cannons!

entity.name: Barbarian
entity.description: This fearless warrior relies on his bulging muscles and striking mustache to wreak havoc in enemy villages. Release a horde of Barbarians and enjoy the mayhem!

superTroop.name: Super Barbarian
superTroop.description: Superior in health, power, speed and most importantly, hair, the Super Barbarians are what regular Barbarians dream of becoming!

entity.name: Super Barbarian
entity.description: Superior in health, power, speed and most importantly, hair, the Super Barbarians are what regular Barbarians dream of becoming!

entity.name: Bowler
entity.description: This big blue dude digs the simple things in life - Dark Elixir drinks and throwing rocks. His massive boulders bounce off of their target and hit again behind it for a double strike!

superTroop.name: Super Bowler
superTroop.description: Super Bowler now has everything he's ever wanted: a grippier glove, more comfortable footwear, and even more ridiculously massive boulders to toss.

entity.name: Super Bowler
entity.description: Super Bowler now has everything he's ever wanted: a grippier glove, more comfortable footwear, and even more ridiculously massive boulders to toss.

entity.name: Dragon Rider
entity.description: This aerial engine of destruction readily and frankly, quite excitedly lays waste to any defense it comes across. The skeleton onboard swears he's not touching the controls.

entity.name: Dragon
entity.description: The might of the dragons is known throughout the land. This scaly terror of the skies feels no mercy and nothing will escape the fiery splashes of his breath.

superTroop.name: Super Dragon
superTroop.description: Sometimes having a fire inside of you isn't enough. The Super Dragon has fires on the inside, outside, and if he gets to do his thing, all around him!

entity.name: Super Dragon
entity.description: Sometimes having a fire inside of you isn't enough. The Super Dragon has fires on the inside, outside, and if he gets to do his thing, all around him!

entity.name: Druid
entity.description: The Druid has complicated emotions. One moment he's calmly helping heal his fellow Troops, and the next he's turned into a very angry Bear.

entity.name: Electro Dragon
entity.description: Possessing iron-tough scales and a breath of devastating lightning, the Electro Dragon's favorite thing is raining destruction from above. When vanquished, the Electro Dragon even pummels the ground with lightning strikes! (6 lightning bolts on death, each dealing the listed death damage to a random target.)

entity.name: Electro Titan
entity.description: Barely controlling her raw magical power, the Electro Titan is a formidable force on the battlefield. She channels some of her magic into a powerful electro whip while the rest spills out to damage everything around her.

entity.name: Furnace
entity.description: The Furnace doesn't move, but it does spawn Firemites over time that target Buildings. These curious little guys leave pools of fire where they visit!

entity.name: Giant
entity.description: These big guys may seem calm, but show them a Cannon or Archer Tower and you'll see their fury unleashed! Slow yet durable, these warriors are best used to soak up hits.

superTroop.name: Super Giant
superTroop.description: Super Giants are bigger than their ordinary cousins and are great at punching their way through walls. The belt is from the annual village eating contest.

entity.name: Super Giant
entity.description: Super Giants are bigger than their ordinary cousins and are great at punching their way through walls. The belt is from the annual village eating contest.

entity.name: Goblin
entity.description: These pesky little creatures only have eyes for one thing: LOOT! They are faster than a Spring Trap, and their hunger for resources is limitless.

superTroop.name: Sneaky Goblin
superTroop.description: Sneaky Goblins have a talent going unnoticed for a while after being deployed. It's usually the incredibly loud sound of resources being pilfered that gives them away.

entity.name: Sneaky Goblin
entity.description: Sneaky Goblins have a talent going unnoticed for a while after being deployed. It's usually the incredibly loud sound of resources being pilfered that gives them away.

entity.name: Golem
entity.description: The mighty Golem loves to soak up damage! When destroyed, it explodes and splits into Golemites. The resulting Golemites have one-fifth the Golem's strength and hitpoints.

entity.name: Headhunter
entity.description: Headhunter has just one job: taking out enemy heroes. As her other job, she works at the village apothecary. She's lightweight enough to jump over walls and her poisoned weapons make her targets move and attack slower.

entity.name: Hog Rider
entity.description: Having tamed the fierce leaping hog, the Hog Rider punishes those who hide behind their puny walls! Fueled by Dark Elixir, these warriors have never known defeat!

superTroop.name: Super Hog Rider
superTroop.description: This dangerous duo of Hog and Rider are even more superb now. They ride together, they split up and keep fighting together.

entity.name: Super Hog Rider
entity.description: This dangerous duo of Hog and Rider are even more superb now. They ride together, they split up and keep fighting together.

entity.name: Ice Golem
entity.description: The Ice Golem has a chilling personality and absolutely zero sense of humour. He frosts over everything he touches, freezes his surroundings when destroyed and ices up when talked to at a party. On defense his freeze effect is smaller and has a shorter duration.

entity.name: Meteor Golem
entity.description: From the cosmos, to your army! This lob-loving duo will throw themselves at anything for up-close damage. When separated, Meteormites will attack nearby targets or find a friend to form a Meteor Golem!

entity.name: Miner
entity.description: He digs underground, passing through Walls to attack your target buildings!

superTroop.name: Super Miner
superTroop.description: Armed with a powerful drill and a magnificent moustache, Super Miner is ready to undermine any rival Village!

entity.name: Super Miner
entity.description: Armed with a powerful drill and a magnificent moustache, Super Miner is ready to undermine any rival Village!

entity.name: Minion
entity.description: This terror of the skies was born out of Dark Elixir. Undetectable by the Seeking Air Mine, Minions materialize with ease, but are fragile in our world.

superTroop.name: Super Minion
superTroop.description: Super Minion's big forehead isn't just for show: sniping enemy defenses from a safe distance is simply a brainy move! Especially when you've grown too big to avoid Seeking Air Mines.

entity.name: Super Minion
entity.description: Super Minion's big forehead isn't just for show: sniping enemy defenses from a safe distance is simply a brainy move! Especially when you've grown too big to avoid Seeking Air Mines.

entity.name: P.E.K.K.A
entity.description: Is P.E.K.K.A a knight? A samurai? A robot? No one knows! P.E.K.K.A's armor absorbs even the mightiest of blows.

entity.name: Root Rider
entity.description: This earth warrior is so in tune with nature she doesn't need to walk herself. Riding into battle atop a tough tree root, Root Rider can smash through Walls and slam Defenses into dust.

entity.name: Ruin Witch
entity.description: After Ruin Witch lost her powers in an unusual alchemy accident, Master Builder crafted an ingenious invention to keep her summoning pursuits alive. The Debrisbuster 5000 vacuums the remains of fallen buildings and spits out battle-ready Ruin Knights.

entity.name: Thrower
entity.description: This powerful pitcher has his eye on the prize! The Thrower hurls mighty spears from long range at enemies and Defenses. His secret? The strength lies in his fabulous facial hair!

entity.name: Valkyrie
entity.description: A master of the two-handed axe, this glorious warrior runs between nearby buildings and can shred several troops or buildings at once with her whirlwind blow!

superTroop.name: Super Valkyrie
superTroop.description: Not only are Super Valkyries superior to regular Valkyries in every way, they're also way more angry!

entity.name: Super Valkyrie
entity.description: Not only are Super Valkyries superior to regular Valkyries in every way, they're also way more angry!

entity.name: Wall Breaker
entity.description: Nothing warms a Wall Breaker's cold and undead heart like blowing up walls. A squad of them will make way for your ground units, and they will do it with a BANG!

superTroop.name: Super Wall Breaker
superTroop.description: Who knew that rolling was so much superior to running? Super Wall Breakers use pre-ignited bombs that blow up under all circumstances! No more duds!

entity.name: Super Wall Breaker
entity.description: Who knew that rolling was so much superior to running? Super Wall Breakers use pre-ignited bombs that blow up under all circumstances! No more duds!

entity.name: Witch
entity.description: The Witch never fights alone, constantly raising dead warriors from past battles to lead her attacks. Upgraded Witches raise more skeletons at a time.

superTroop.name: Super Witch
superTroop.description: Focused magic creates focused results. Instead of summoning hordes of tiny Skeletons, Super Witch summons just one really big skeleton with very formidable bone density.

entity.name: Super Witch
entity.description: Focused magic creates focused results. Instead of summoning hordes of tiny Skeletons, Super Witch summons just one really big skeleton with very formidable bone density.

entity.name: Wizard
entity.description: The Wizard is a terrifying presence on the battlefield. Pair him up with some of his fellows and cast concentrated blasts of destruction on anything, land or sky!

superTroop.name: Super Wizard
superTroop.description: Super Wizard is positively charged with magical energy! He's either the smartest person in the room... or else he blows the whole room to bits.

entity.name: Super Wizard
entity.description: Super Wizard is positively charged with magical energy! He's either the smartest person in the room... or else he blows the whole room to bits.

entity.name: Yeti
entity.description: The heavy-hitting furry fellow digs cold weather and his Yetimite buddies. Hurt him, and you'll make the Yetimites real angry.

superTroop.name: Super Yeti
superTroop.description: This mysterious masked Yeti is charged up! His electrical little buddies spring into action when he takes damage and zap the closest Building to spark a devastating chain reaction!

entity.name: Super Yeti
entity.description: This mysterious masked Yeti is charged up! His electrical little buddies spring into action when he takes damage and zap the closest Building to spark a devastating chain reaction!

entity.name: Wall
entity.description: Walls are great for keeping your village safe and your enemies in the line of fire.
